The named representations a structure is drawn with

Source: R/structureViewer.R
INTERNAL_structure_selections.Rd

Shared by structureViewer() (initial render) and the module's proxy updates (restyling without reloading), so both draw the same thing. Each element is list(type, param) with param$name set, so a representation can later be removed by name.

Usage

.structure_selections(
  x,
  representation = "cartoon",
  color.by = NULL,
  highlight = NULL,
  highlight.color = "#E7298A",
  highlight.representation = "ball+stick",
  show.ligands = TRUE,
  band.colors = c("#0053D6", "#65CBF3", "#FFDB13", "#FF7D45")
)

Arguments

x

An object from read_structure().

representation

NGL representation for the polymer: "cartoon", "backbone", "ribbon", "rope", "surface", "ball+stick", "licorice" or "spacefill".

color.by

Colour scheme (see Details). Default: "plddt" for an AlphaFold model, else "chainname".

highlight

Residues to highlight, as text (see Details), or NULL.

highlight.color

Colour of the highlighted residues.

highlight.representation

Representation of the highlighted residues.

show.ligands

Logical; draw ligands and ions as ball-and-stick.

band.colors

Colours of the four pLDDT bands, from very high to very low (the AlphaFold DB colours by default).

Value

A list of representations.
